camel_example: aliyun ddoscoo CreateWebCCRule --region cn-hangzhou --Act close --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm2pz25js0000' --Mode prefix --Count 60 --Domain 'www.aliyun.com' --Ttl 60 --Uri '/abc/a.php' --Name testrule --Interval 20
description_en: Creates a custom frequency control rule for a website
description_zh: 创建网站业务频率控制防护（CC防护）的自定义规则
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo create-web-cc-rule --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --domain www.aliyun.com --name testrule --act close --count 60 --interval 20 --biz-mode prefix --ttl 60 --uri /abc/a.php --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateWebCCRule

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。

域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The name of the rule. The name can be up to 128 characters in length and contain letters, digits, and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。支持使用英文字母、数字或下划线（_），且长度不能超过128个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The action on the requests that trigger the custom frequency control rule. Valid values:

close: blocks the requests.
captcha: triggers Completely Automated Public Turing test to tell Computers and Humans Apart (CAPTCHA) verification for the requests
parameters.help_zh:
对命中防护规则的请求执行的动作。取值：

close：表示封禁该请求。
captcha：表示发起人机识别验证
parameters.name: act

parameters.help_zh: 单一IP访问次数。取值范围：2~2000
parameters.name: count

parameters.help_zh: 检测时长。取值范围：5~10800，单位：秒
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The matching mode. Valid values:

prefix: prefix match.
match: exact match.

If the URI of the check path contains parameters, you must set this parameter to prefix
parameters.help_zh:
匹配模式。取值：
prefix：表示前缀匹配。
match：表示完全匹配。

检测路径URI中包含参数时，请选择前缀匹配（prefix）
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The blocking duration. Valid values: 60 to 86400. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 封禁时长。取值范围：60~86400，单位：秒
parameters.name: ttl

parameters.help_en:
The check path.

The URI cannot be modified. The domain name of the website, the check path, and the rule name uniquely identify a rule
parameters.help_zh:
检测路径。
URI不支持修改。网站业务的域名，检测路径，规则名称唯一确定一条规则
parameters.name: uri
